form.description: One asymmetric, closed, thick cloud bank: two offset major crowns, a lower bent side return, a low forward shoulder, a broad hooked trough with a blind branch, and a continuous belly

controls.editable: crest height and asymmetric crown fullness; no translation of the whole bank

controls.shape: Bent lower return ridge with two broad unequal shoulders, not another detached peak

floor height within 735..780 and width multiplier 0.9..1.1; blind branch end rises, never cuts through belly or contact collar

collar_rule: The listed bounds only locate irregular masks; do not fill the rectangles. Preserve each actual old/neighbor projected-overlap component; lock seam outer and lower envelopes to the old surface, transition inward over 50..100m. Obtain exact constraints from the frozen saved triangles before any eventual construction. No control may extend coverage over a neighbor to hide it.

proposed_topology.construction: Coarse authored contour cage following the nonconvex silhouette, crown/shoulder loops in two dimensions, trough floor and both walls, continuous rounded flanks and lower shell. No boolean union of sphere chains, roof extrusions, or view-facing planes.
proposed_topology.normal_policy: Normals derive from actual outward oriented geometry; flat polygon/triangle shading with deliberately broad geometric orientation variation. No fake camera-facing or painted normals. Triangulation diagonals are persistent and deterministic.

material_contract: First geometry candidate uses the existing K lit opaque two-sided StandardMaterial values unchanged: sRGB albedo [0.7735731,0.7977378,0.8378605,1], roughness 0.899999976, metallic 0, Burley diffuse, no texture, emission, vertex-color albedo or extra pass. Shared world Sun/ambient/fog/lightning and time remain unchanged.

fixed_world_cameras.rule: Copy the four actual saved transform/projection byte strings. Never recompute side/back or near from the NEW bounds center.
